name: Ioun Stone of Leadership
description: A sphere marbled pink and green.
body:
## What it does

While it circles you, your Charisma rises by 2, to no more than 20.

## In flight

Toss it into the air as an action and it circles your head 1d3 feet away. Pluck it from the air or catch it in a net to stop it; another creature that wants it must hit it first (AC 24, 10 hit points, resistant to all damage). Stored, it does nothing.
